Definition: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
BiblicalUsage: 1) to put to shame, be ashamed, be disconcerted, be disappointed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to feel shame; 1a2) to be ashamed, disconcerted, disappointed (by reason of); 1b) (Piel) to delay (in shame); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to put to shame; 1c2) to act shamefully; 1c3) to be ashamed; 1d) (Hithpolel) to be ashamed before one another
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
